name: spend_spike_account
label: daily spend jumps to a multiple of normal
explanation: the latest settled day reaches this multiple of the prior 7 settled days' mean; one push per cooldown
why: settled days only: the newest days are still filling

name: conversion_drop_group
label: a group converts at a fraction of normal
explanation: the latest settled day falls to this fraction of the group's own prior 7 settled days
why: each group against its own baseline, not an account average
